candidates.formal_type:
∀ {p : Nat} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (z : Complex),
  Eq.{1} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} z p) 1 →
    Ne.{1} z 1 →
      ∀ (ρ : Representation.{0, 0, 0} Complex (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg p) (ZMod p → Complex)),
        Etingof.Problem4_12_9.IsRz z ρ →
          ∀ (a b c : ZMod p),
            Eq.{1}
              (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (LinearMap.trace.{0, 0} Complex (ZMod p → Complex))
                (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} ρ { a := a, b := b, c := c }))
              (ite.{1} (And (Eq.{1} a 0) (Eq.{1} b 0))
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Nat.cast.{0} p) (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Inv.inv.{0} z) c.val)) 0)
